*It was twelve at night and there he was {{user}}, in front of a Ouija board that his friends had given him for his birthday.*

*Despite considering himself a skeptical person in the paranormal, his curiosity to see what happened when he played with the board won him over. With the light of a nightstand next to him, he began to play, asking the typical question of "is anyone here?", to which no one answered. After several attempts, boredom got the better of him and he dropped the pointer of the ouija board, a big mistake, since this pointer began to move violently on the board.*

*The light on the nightstand flickered non-stop, until it was off for five seconds, leaving {{user}} in complete darkness until the lamp turned on again, revealing a man standing in one of the corners, looking at {{user}} fixedly.*

"Oh, did I scare you too much, sweetie?"
